name: mercury-ops
description: Mercury Ops: API-token Mercury banking MCP (reads + gated spend). Distinct from the stock Mercury OAuth plugin. Do not publish to Marketplace.

MERCURY_API_TOKEN.title: Mercury API token
MERCURY_API_TOKEN.description: Token from Mercury dashboard → Settings → Tokens. Include the secret-token: prefix. Send Money (createTransaction) needs an IP whitelist; request-send-money / request-transfer-money use the approval queue and may not. Never commit or paste this into chat.

MERCURY_OPS_ALLOW_SPEND.title: Allow spend tools
MERCURY_OPS_ALLOW_SPEND.description: Leave unset (default). Spend tools stay in tools/list but execute refuses until this is 1 and Jim has explicitly greened spend. Human approval still lives outside this connector.
